title: On-Demand Signed Claims (ODSC) micro-credits pilot for rapid CAIQ snapshots
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Run a scoped pilot that sells single-use, signed security evidence artifacts (On-Demand Signed Claims, ODSC) to accelerate enterprise contract cycles. ODSC are cryptographically signed CAIQ section snapshots (or scoped attestations) that customers can attach to RFPs or contract docs. The pilot tests a per-section micro-credit pricing model, a Console flow for issuance, and a backend signing service integrated with KMS/HSM and audit logs.
acceptance_criteria: MVP backend can mint signed CAIQ section JSON with KMS-backed signature and TTL enforced
Console UI flow: request > entitlement check > pay-credit modal > immediate download of signed claim
Billing logs record per-section credit debit and expose line-item in usage dashboard
Pilot cohort (10 enterprise customers) onboarded and able to request at least one signed claim each
Legal sign-off on claim format, TTL policies (default 30 days) and revocation procedure
decisions: Use per-section micro-credit model (default price: $50 equivalent credit per section) for pilot instead of unlimited bundles
Default TTL for issued claims: 30 days; allow requests for 7/14/30 day options in MVP
Require customer account to be on trial/paid tier with entitlement flag to request ODSC
Signatures will be JSON Web Signatures (JWS) with key material in customer-managed KMS for Private deployments and Redwood KMS for hosted pilot customers
Rate-limit issuance: 50 claims/day per org for pilot; refine via telemetry
